verses.verse:
उपर्युपरि नादेषु फूत्कारो बलवान् भवेत्।
अवरोहे तु नादेषु क्रमसः प्राणन्यूनता।८९।
verses.text: In each higher sound the blowing should be stronger; and in descending through the sounds there is a gradual lessening of breath.

commentary.text: That is, as the sound climbs higher, more force has to be given to the breath, and when the sound begins to come down, in that descending state weakness comes gradually into the breath. But how much should this more-or-less breath be? In this the guru's (teacher's) contribution will be necessary. Otherwise this judgement can go wrong.
